value.summary: Renamed the two helpers in lib/util.mjs: doubleInternal(n) is now double(n) and halveInternal(n) is now halve(n), bodies unchanged (n * 2, n / 2). Added alias exports doubleInternal = double and halveInternal = halve at the bottom of the file so old imports keep resolving to the same functions. Only lib/util.mjs was modified, per the declared write target; the existing tests were not touched.

observations.statement: lib/util.mjs now exports double and halve (satisfying the RF-001-A/RF-002-A file-content checks) plus the doubleInternal/halveInternal aliases expected by the existing tests.

evidenceCandidates.statement: lib/util.mjs contains "export function double" with body n * 2, matching RF-001-A.
lib/util.mjs contains "export function halve" with body n / 2, matching RF-002-A.

doubleInternal and halveInternal are re-exported as aliases of the renamed functions, which should keep tests/util.test.mjs passing; final verification belongs to the RF-C01-A command in the verify task.
